candidates.change_summary: Change assignment to acc.unlockTime so it is always set to the provided _unlockTime (no clamp to block.timestamp), allowing future or past unlockTimes to be recorded directly.
Set acc.unlockTime to block.timestamp unconditionally (ignoring provided _unlockTime), making Put always reset unlocking to now.
Invert the conditional and set acc.unlockTime to block.timestamp when _unlockTime is greater; otherwise set to _unlockTime, flipping the original clamp behavior.
Insert a require that _unlockTime must be greater than current acc.unlockTime, rejecting calls that attempt to decrease the unlock time.
Insert a statement that adds the provided _unlockTime to acc.balance (affecting stored balance observable after Put).
Replace the LogFile.AddMessage call with a no-op (delete the logging call), removing the emitted log message effect of Put.
Move the acc.balance increment to after setting acc.unlockTime, changing the order of state updates visible after Put completion.
Set acc.balance to msg.value instead of adding, overwriting prior balance and changing observable balance after Put.
Change the transfer call to use transfer (throws on failure) instead of low-level call, replacing the call{value:_am}("") block.
Remove the balance deduction before sending funds so balance is decremented only if the external call succeeds (move deduction after successful call).
Invert the unlock time comparison to require block.timestamp < acc.unlockTime (prevents collection when previously allowed), changing the conditional guard.
